title: Vantage Reserves 1 GW of Manufacturing Capacity for Nvidia 800 VDC Power
summary:
Heron Power and Vantage Data Centers have signed an agreement to build specialized electricity hardware for next-generation server facilities. The deal includes reserving more than 1 GW of manufacturing capacity for Heron Link, a system that combines power conversion, protection, and distribution into one cabinet. The equipment converts medium-voltage grid power directly to 800 VDC to meet the power architecture requirements set by Nvidia for AI data centers and hyperscale campuses.

The move toward native 800 VDC aims to transform AI data centers into more flexible and reliable assets for the power grid. Baglino of Heron Power described the current 1 GW reservation as the first of many gigawatts to come as the industry transitions to this power standard.
